about_the_game:
Monkey Jump is not just another banana collecting game it’s a physics-driven survival experience infused with horror.

Playable with up to 8 players, this chaotic adventure throws you into story-driven maps where the hunt for bananas quickly turns into a fight for survival. With physics shaping every move, a single mistake can pull the entire group into disaster.

Stay alert.
Because the line between hunter and prey is thinner than you think.

  • Physics-based chaos – Jump, collide, fall, and get thrown around… every action is bound by the laws of Newton.

  • 8-player survival – Form strategies, cooperate in the chaos, or risk going alone.

  • Terrifying environments – From abandoned forests to dark tunnels, every map carries its own story and danger.

  • Cosmetic customization – Personalize your character and show your style, even in the heart of fear.

Collecting bananas is easy…
Getting back with them is the real challenge.
